risks.risk: You may not be buying a PS4 console at all—photos only show a controller.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the full PS4 console (front and back ports) plus the power cable and HDMI cable connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller-only (not a PS4 bundle).

risks.risk: The console may not be hacked/jailbroken as claimed (or may be unstable/banned).
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing the console booting to the home screen and any visible jailbreak/hack menu/app, plus a quick game launch.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not hacked / standard console.

risks.risk: The listed games may not be included, may be wrong versions, or may not work.
risks.proof: Ask for clear photos of all 6 game discs/cases (front and back) OR screenshots showing the games installed and playable.

risks.risk: Possible hardware issues (disc drive not reading, overheating, faulty controller ports).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video test: console boots, disc/game loads (or downloads/install screen), and controller works in-game.

risks.risk: Model/version (PS4 Slim/Pro/other) is unknown, which affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the console label/model number (sticker) and the exact model shown on system settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest PS4 value tier.

proof_requests: Photo of the full PS4 console (front + back ports) and the power/HDMI cables.
Photo of the console label/model number (sticker) and/or a screenshot from Settings > System Information.
Video showing the console booting and the home screen (and any visible hack/jailbreak indicator if it exists).
Clear photos of all 6 games (discs/cases) or screenshots showing they are installed and playable.
Short gameplay/video test launching at least one of the claimed games.
response.reason: From the photos, only a controller is visible and there is no evidence of a PS4 console, the claimed hack status, or the 6 games. A worst-case price for the bundle can’t be set confidently without proof of the console and included games.
